maintenance_led.reason: Sells virgin sulfuric acid, sulfur dioxide and acid regeneration services—recurring process inputs and services, not maintenance of customers' installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private refiners, miners, battery makers and water treatment firms; revenue is paid by private industry.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own operations and regeneration plants; Calabrian is one notable acquisition, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Acid regeneration for refiners' alkylate units and catalyst sulfiding are integrated into customer processes; switching risks downtime and requalification.
